name: note/UX-B-13
text: UX-B-13 — '+ Add page' routes through the uniqueness helpers duplicate already uses (PageManager.ts:460-475), so two adds after a delete produce two different names at two different URLs. Today createPage checks neither (PageManager.ts:61-93) and the exporter silently dedupes the collision to page-3-2.html (ExportEngine.ts:789-795) — a URL the user never chose and never sees.
